before_implementation_summary: No dedicated import/export/bulk capability existed. Files, jobs, audit, guardrails, observability, API contracts, providers, config, and tenant/PDP substrates existed.
after_implementation_items: packages/core bulk operation model, format safety, validation/item evidence, evidence-package manifest, and audit event taxonomy
substrates_connected: DB/RLS posture via tenant IDs and source-use matrix; durable DB runtime deferred
PDP via PolicyDecisionPoint for privileged bulk/import/export actions
audit via AuditRecorder and bulk lifecycle event taxonomy
files via FileMetadataStore scan/quarantine and file_id posture
provider modes via live-external-deferred provider transfer posture
config/secrets via standard requiring no secrets and SecretReference-only provider future depth
